method.cameraCenter: Equal arithmetic mean of per-device medians; device image counts do not weight the pooled center.
method.scale: 1.4826 times MAD around the equal-device camera center with a fixed 1e-6 floor.
method.redundancy: Greedy deterministic selection; absolute Spearman rho >= 0.90 is redundant and the higher-quality feature is retained.
method.score: Weighted linear sum of bounded feature components: clamp(0.5 + direction * (value - midpoint) / (2 * (abs(controlCenter-cameraCenter) + scale)), 0, 1).
method.threshold: 10th percentile of training-camera scores only; higher score is more camera-consistent.

shortcutAudit.method: Descriptive Spearman association only; nuisance values were not passed to the feature extractor or v1 score.

deviceAudit.method: Descriptive score distributions by development device; no device classifier was fitted.
